function.name: archive_documents
function.description: Archives a list of documents based on document IDs and an optional expiration date for archival. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

document_ids.description: A list of unique identifier strings for the documents to be archived.

expire_date.description: The expiration date for the archival in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD', such as '2023-12-31'. If not provided, defaults to 'null' which implies no expiration.

notify_user.description: Flag indicating whether to notify the user upon successful archival. Defaults to false.

message.content:
Shashi Tej Reddy is an Indian entrepreneur best known for founding **ReddyTech Solutions**, a mid‑size IT services firm headquartered in Hyderabad. Born in 1975 in Secunderabad, he earned a B.Tech in Computer Science from Osmania University before working at Infosys for six years. In 2008 he left Infosys to start ReddyTech, focusing on cloud‑based enterprise solutions for small and medium‑sized businesses.

Under his leadership, ReddyTech grew from a handful of developers to over 300 employees by 2019, expanding into the United States and Southeast Asia. He has been recognized by *Business Standard* as one of “India’s 40 Under 40” entrepreneurs (2017) and was named “Entrepreneur of the Year” by the Hyderabad Chamber of Commerce in 2020.

In addition to his business activities, Shashi Tej Reddy serves on the board of the Hyderabad Startup Hub and mentors young tech founders through the “Future Innovators” program. He holds a Master’s degree in Business Administration from the Indian Institute of Management Bangalore (IIM‑B).
